contract.question: Will Zohran Mamdani win the 2025 NYC mayoral election?
contract.rulesSummary: YES if Mamdani wins the November 4, 2025 NYC general election; AP, Fox News and NBC agreement or official certification determines resolution.

dataReadiness.measurement: Hourly YES contract price; descriptive percentage-point response, no causal attribution and no missing-bucket filling.
dataReadiness.editorialCaveat: The primary breakthrough is +33.80 pp; the other four cards range from -1.025 to +1.80 pp. This is a real consequence pattern, but not five similarly sized shocks.

cards.text: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez endorses Zohran Mamdani for New York City mayor.
cards.whyItMattered: A nationally recognizable progressive endorsement signaled outsider momentum and coalition support.
cards.caveat: The post confirms support but does not prove it was the first public announcement.

cards.text: Andrew Cuomo concedes the Democratic primary to Zohran Mamdani.
cards.whyItMattered: The insurgent's primary breakthrough removed the establishment favorite from the Democratic contest and changed the general-election field.
cards.caveat: Returns were already rolling in; this card captures the primary-night breakthrough around the concession, not the November resolving result.

cards.text: Andrew Cuomo announces he will continue running for mayor as an independent.
cards.whyItMattered: The defeated rival re-entered the general election, preserving a credible anti-Mamdani lane.
cards.caveat: The continuation had been discussed earlier, so the announcement confirmed an anticipated option.

cards.text: Governor Kathy Hochul endorses Mamdani for New York City mayor.
cards.whyItMattered: The sitting governor's support brought a major party establishment figure behind the insurgent nominee.
cards.caveat: The endorsement followed public discussions and coalition expectations; the response cannot be isolated from surrounding September news.

cards.text: Mayor Eric Adams ends his re-election campaign.
cards.whyItMattered: The incumbent's exit changed the opposition field and how anti-Mamdani votes could be distributed.
cards.caveat: Withdrawal had been speculated about and another major anti-Mamdani candidate remained in the race.

ending.text: Zohran Mamdani won the November 4, 2025 NYC general election; the contract resolved YES.
